name: FurMe
tagline: A Furby-shaped desk assistant that follows your face, reads your mood and talks back.
problem: The event theme was nostalgia; the team wanted the companionship of a childhood toy to become useful today.
solution: A physical Furby-like body that turns toward the user, detects emotion from the face to play mood-matched childhood songs, converses and tells jokes, with a web dashboard chatbot and a home-security camera view.
demo_moment: A Furby turns to look at you, notices you look down, and plays a song from your childhood.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Answered the nostalgia theme with the most recognizable toy of the judges' childhood rather than a literal 'retro' app.
A living physical object on the table; most theme entries were web apps.
Feature list is broad (chatbot, security, music, jokes) — a kitchen-sink risk the physical character carried.

lessons: For a themed event, the winning move is the theme's most emotionally loaded object, made functional.
